name: IQGROUP
recent: IQGROUP 于 2026 年 8 月 27 日召开第 23 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均以投票方式通过。公司同时提交了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告，并更新了公司注册地址。近期没有相关新闻。

recent_en: IQGROUP held its 23rd AGM on 27 August 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were passed by poll. The company also filed its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 June 2026 and changed its registered address. There was no recent news.
notable_en: The 23rd AGM was held on 27 August 2026 and all ordinary resolutions were passed by poll.

The company changed its registered address.
